items.label: Breaking
items.text: Rapture countdown clock upgraded to include leap seconds; optimism unchanged.

items.label: Watch
items.text: Blood moon spotted over strip mall; prophecy tour bus reroutes for ‘strategic viewing’.

items.label: Report
items.text: ‘This generation’ calculator now accepts life expectancy inputs and a grace period slider.

items.label: Developing
items.text: Third Temple fundraising tier reveals VIP ribbon-cutting access; ashes of red heifer sold separately.

items.label: Update
items.text: Antichrist shortlist narrowed to 12 after committee discovers several were already disqualified in 2016.

items.label: Report
items.text: Left Behind book club announces ‘post-Rapture snacks’ potluck; asks members to label items for whoever’s left.
